newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Beta Finance raises 5-yr Navigator to 7.5 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: Beta Finance raises 5-yr Navigator to 7.5 bln esc.

text.p: Beta Finance Corp has raised a five-year Navigator bond issue by 2.5 billion escudos to 7.5 billion at a fixed rate of 6.85 percent, joint leaders Citibank Portugal (bookrunner) and Citibank International Plc said.
The increase was due to strong demand by institutional investors and banks, they said.
Type: part of programme of medium term notes of issuer
Payment of interest: on October 30 each year
Admission to quotation: London stock exchange
Joint leaders: Citibank Portugal (bookrunner) and Citibank International
Senior co-leaders: Banco Santander de Negocios Portugal, Banco Finantia
Co-leaders: Banco Espirito Santo, Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor, Deutsche Bank de Investimento, Banco Essi, Merrill Lynch
International Managers: Banco Mello de Investimentos, Argentaria Bex, Caixa Economica Montepio Geral
